# Translation and Codon Optimization

<!-- Generated by contract_docs.py; edit canonical definitions. -->

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. The connector generates a readable
experiment name when one is omitted; report the returned name. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## CodonRLBERT

Optimize / predict codon usage for a protein sequence (CodonRL + BERT).

Exact job name: `CodonRLBERT`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fasta_file` | string | yes | file | FASTA of protein sequence(s). Upload via `file_upload` first, then pass the returned platform path here |
| `name` | string | yes | value | Run label placed **inside `experimentData`**; e.g. `"prime"` |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "fasta_file": {
      "description": "FASTA of protein sequence(s). Upload via `file_upload` first, then pass the returned platform path here",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "name": {
      "description": "Run label placed **inside `experimentData`**; e.g. `\"prime\"`",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "fasta_file",
    "name"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json
{
  "job_name": "CodonRLBERT",
  "experiment_name": "<optional; generated if omitted>",
  "experiment_data": {
    "fasta_file": "<user value; see fasta_file schema>",
    "name": "<user value; see name schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

### File checks

```json

  "fasta_file": {
    "formats": [],
    "header_case_sensitive": true,
    "notes": "FASTA of protein sequence(s). Upload via `file_upload` first, then pass the returned platform path here"
  }
}
```

Report actual service errors and incomplete outputs. Refresh status for expired links.

## RNA Translational Efficiency Prediction

Predict translational efficiency for sequences (organism-specific model).

Exact job name: `transla_score`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`. The connector generates `experiment_name` unless the user supplies one.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `organism` | string | yes | value | `"human"` / `"mouse"` / `"ecole"` (string). Proven value: `"mouse"`. Note: source lists `"ecole"` — likely E. coli / `"ecoli"`; confirm the exact token on the first non-mouse/human run |
| `input_csv` | string | yes | file | CSV input for the prediction. Upload via `file_upload` first, then pass the returned platform path. The source requires a `Sequence` header. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "organism": {
      "description": "`\"human\"` / `\"mouse\"` / `\"ecole\"` (string). Proven value: `\"mouse\"`. Note: source lists `\"ecole\"` — likely E. coli / `\"ecoli\"`; confirm the exact token on the first non-mouse/human run",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "human",
        "mouse",
        "ecole"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "input_csv": {
      "description": "CSV input for the prediction. Upload via `file_upload` first, then pass the returned platform path. The source requires a `Sequence` header.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "organism",
    "input_csv"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json
{
  "job_name": "transla_score",
  "experiment_name": "<optional; generated if omitted>",
  "experiment_data": {
    "organism": "<user value; see organism schema>",
    "input_csv": "<user value; see input_csv schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.
